purpose: Offline reclassification of locally saved MC event data under the rule that a non-intercepted attacker entering the 3-m protected-asset radius terminates the episode as a failure.
attacker_deadline_method: Exact local replay of the stable scripted-attacker dynamics and paper preset without defenders; evaluated separately for each attacker/target.
case2_extra_condition_reason: Retains the user's preceding request to show only the strongly synchronized Case 2 trials.
metric_values: The four stored episode metrics are unchanged; only the episode population is reclassified.
figure_labels: Case 1 and Case 2 only, as requested
limitations: This is an event-table reclassification, not a rerun with an in-loop asset-breach terminal condition. Full per-step histories were saved only for one representative episode per case.
